purpose: Teach: ディベート/主体性/スパン/税額/キャスティング/特技/創意/突出

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員研修、本気で、絶対、ディベート、絶対、形式を、絶対、取り入れろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I want you to integrate debate into the staff training program. I'm serious about this.
lines.style: Firm, direct delivery. Short clipped phrases. Measured pace, no hesitation. Each sentence lands with weight—this is a directive, not a suggestion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新人の主体性、本気で、絶対、引き出すよう、絶対、努めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're working hard to draw out initiative in our new hires.
lines.style: Respectful, measured cadence. Steady eye contact held. Formal register maintained throughout. A professional acknowledgment of the instruction.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 長期スパン、本気で、絶対、見据えて、絶対、計画を、絶対、立てろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Plan ahead. Think in long-term cycles, not quarter to quarter.
lines.style: Deliberate, slightly slowed tempo. Slight emphasis on 'long-term' to anchor the point. Calm but insistent—wisdom delivered without lecture.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。前期の税額、本気で、絶対、申告、絶対、適切に、絶対、進めました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. We handled last quarter's tax filings carefully and on schedule.
lines.style: Professional confirmation. Quiet confidence in the delivery. Brief pause after 'sir'—respect without obsequiousness. Matter-of-fact tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 広告の、本気で、絶対、キャスティング、絶対、慎重に、絶対、選定しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Be careful with casting decisions for the advertising. Don't rush them.
lines.style: Steady, cautionary undertone. Slight elongation on 'careful'—emphasis without raising volume. Patient but expectant. The tone of someone who knows details matter.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の特技、本気で、絶対、業務に、絶対、活かす、絶対、取り組み、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. We're actively working to use each team member's strengths in their roles.
lines.style: Engaged and earnest. Slightly quicker pace to show momentum and effort. Warm undertone—pride in the work being done, not defensiveness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 各部署、本気で、絶対、創意工夫を、絶対、競わせろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Have each department push themselves. Create healthy competition on innovation.
lines.style: Energized delivery. Slight rise in tempo on 'competition'—forward momentum. Encouraging rather than harsh. The tone of a leader motivating, not threatening.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社の業績、本気で、絶対、業界で、絶対、突出、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. Our company performance is genuinely standing out in the industry right now.
lines.style: Clear, straightforward statement. Quiet note of pride underneath. Steady pacing. A factual observation delivered with subtle satisfaction—the result of all this effort.
